description: Adapter supports server-sent chunked output via stream(). The stream() method must yield AdapterChunk objects and end with a done chunk.
Adapter supports tool/function calling. Adapters must accept tools in AdapterRequest and return toolCalls in AdapterResponse when the model invokes a tool.
Adapter supports structured JSON output via the responseFormat field on AdapterRequest. The adapter guarantees the response content is valid JSON matching the provided schema.
Adapter accepts image inputs in message content blocks. Images may be provided as base64-encoded data or as URLs depending on the vendor.
Adapter accepts PDF inputs in message content blocks.
Adapter can execute server-side web search to ground responses in current information.
Adapter supports prompt-caching / cache-control markers. See also vendor:anthropic:extended-thinking for vendor-specific cache semantics.
OpenAI-specific JSON mode activated via response_format: { type: 'json_object' }. Guarantees valid JSON output but does not enforce a schema. Superseded by fl:json-mode for schema-constrained output.
Anthropic extended thinking capability. The model produces an internal chain-of-thought (thinking blocks) before the final response. Activated via the thinking field on AdapterRequest.
